The main takeaway from our work is that

, by using a stable embedding of the manifold into a Euclidean space, one can design a tracking controller that is provably stable in the absence of any assumptions on the system dynamics, and is also robust to model uncertainty.

, for systems with dynamics on a manifold, it is possible to design controllers that are computationally efficient and robust to model uncertainty by exploiting the manifold structure and using tools from differential geometry.
